verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships a first-party AgentOS toolkit, documented by a probe as an official MCP server, that lets AI agents act on a production account (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, building cashflow reports). Users can therefore operate the account in natural language, but only through an external AI agent; the evidence shows no native natural-language command interface in Airwallex itself. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language interface within Airwallex, documented end-to-end natural-language command examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Airwallex AgentOS is a toolkit for AI agents that need to act on your production Airwallex account — reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, building cashflow reports
